name: Leon
source: The childhood friend next door who grew up with a huge crush on the main character. He's athletic, friendly, dependable, and will murder anyone who upsets the protagonist remotely. Although he lived his life believing he'd be happy so long as the main character is happy, he's recently found that he only wants the protagonist to be happy with him...
